checkpoint_selection: highest mean deterministic development return; earliest step on ties; save all selected hashes before any final episode
physical_model: unchanged frozen paper-v2 physics, CSI acquisition, router, reward and codebooks
inference: greedy physical and communication categorical actions
training_policy: fresh training with new replicate seeds; never extend or reuse screening checkpoints
final_policy: open the reserved final set exactly once after all 16 selected checkpoint hashes are locked; no selection, retuning or retraining on final outcomes
matched_training_design: eight independent pairs: algorithms in each pair share actor/critic initialization seed, episode scenario IDs, minibatch RNG and training budget; matching verified before final and used for paired inference; pairs are independent of one another
primary_test: two-sided exact sign-flip over eight matched training pairs for algorithms and eight within-policy delivery interventions; Holm adjustment over two hypotheses
confidence_intervals: 10000 nested bootstrap draws over matched training pairs and shared final scenario IDs; pair correspondence is preserved for both primary comparisons
content_intervention: replay every selected-policy send action on matched scenario/time; preserve sender IDs, availability, destinations, accepted counts and timing; physical actions may change
interpretation: report measured effects and uncertainty regardless of direction; intervals are not equivalence tests; confirmation concerns communication only
